challengeTypes: identify: What comes next in: triangle, circle, triangle, circle, ___? (Triangle vs Square vs Star)
identify: What comes next in: 2, 4, 6, 8, ___? (10 vs 9 vs 11)
identify: What comes next in: red, blue, red, blue, ___? (Red vs Green vs Yellow)
sort: Drag shapes to complete the pattern (AB pattern: triangle goes first, circle goes second | AAB pattern: two squares then a circle)
identify: What comes next in: 1, 3, 5, 7, ___? (9 vs 8 vs 10)
identify: Is 3, 1, 7, 2, 9 a pattern? (No, it has no rule vs Yes, it counts vs Yes, it is a pattern)
sort: Drag items to complete different patterns (AB: triangle-circle | AABB: star-star-heart-heart | ABC: red-blue-green)
sort: Drag number patterns to the right rule (Count by 2: 2,4,6,8,10 | Count by 1: 1,2,3,4,5 | Count by 3: 3,6,9,12,15)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) A pattern is when things repeat in the same order again and again. (2) Find the repeating unit (AB, AABB, ABC). (3) Number patterns count by a rule (by 1, by 2, by 3). (4) Look at the gap between numbers to find the rule. Misconceptions: "next item = last item I saw" (look at the whole repeating unit), "2,4,6,8 next is 9" (counts by 2, so 8+2=10), "any arrangement is a pattern" (a pattern must follow a repeating rule). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PatternsGame), NOT export default. Export interface PatternsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
